values.name: Storage temperature
values.description: The temperature at which the cargo is to be kept while it is in storage.

values.name: Transport temperature
values.description: The temperature at which cargo is to be kept while it is under transport.

values.name: Cargo operating temperature
values.description: The temperature at which cargo is to be kept during cargo handling.

values.name: Transport emergency temperature
values.description: The temperature at which emergency procedures apply for the disposal of temperature-controlled goods.

values.name: Transport control temperature
values.description: The maximum temperature at which certain products can be safely transported.
